title: Emergency Plumbing & Heating
tagline: No heat. No hot water. Burst pipe. Call — Shane comes out.
meta_desc: 24/7 emergency plumber serving Saugus, the North Shore, and Boston. Frozen pipes, burst lines, no-heat boiler failures, water heater leaks. Call 781-820-4592 — Shane answers.
intro: Plumbing and heating emergencies don't wait for business hours. Burst pipes, no heat in January, no hot water Saturday morning, gas leaks, sewage backups — Shane Meredith comes out personally, with parts on the truck, ready to make the call to fix and the call to wait until Monday.

scenarios.b: Boiler down, pilot out, circulator failed, no-fire. Same-day Saturday is the rule, not the exception. Most repairs done on the first visit.
Tank failure, pilot out, thermocouple, control board. We diagnose first, swap the part if it's fixable, replace the unit same-day if it's not.
We shut it down, thaw what's salvageable, repair or replace what isn't. Insurance-ready photos and invoicing every time.
Backed-up drains, failed sump pumps, ejector pumps. Containment first, repair second, sanitation last.
If you smell gas, leave the building and call the utility first — then call us for the repair side. Licensed gas fitter, code-compliant repair, pressure-tested before sign-off.

guarantee: All emergency labor backed by our 1-year workmanship guarantee. Manufacturer warranty applies to all parts and equipment (typically 5–12 years on boilers and water heaters).

title: Water Heater Replacement & Repair
h1: Water heater replacement in Saugus & the North Shore
tagline: Tank, tankless, gas, electric, power-vent. Same-day swaps when yours quits.
meta_desc: Same-day water heater replacement and repair across the North Shore. Tank, tankless, power-vent, gas, electric. Free written quotes. Call 781-820-4592 — Shane answers.
intro: When a water heater fails it's almost never convenient. Shane stocks the truck for the common units (40 and 50 gallon gas + electric, plus power-vent and tankless rough-ins), so most replacements get done same-day — pulled out, set in, lines connected, hauled away.

scenarios.b: Standard residential replacement. Most homes in Saugus, Lynn, and Revere run a 40 or 50-gallon atmospheric or power-vent tank. We carry both and can usually swap same-day.
Necessary when there's no natural draft chimney or when an existing vent doesn't meet code. Power-vent units run quiet, vent through PVC, and last 8–12 years on average.

Endless hot water, smaller footprint, longer service life. Right answer for some homes — not all. We'll walk through whether your gas line, venting, and water hardness make tankless the better economic call.

scenarios.h: Leaking tank, no hot water, pilot won't light
scenarios.b: Diagnose first. If it's a thermocouple, control board, or element — repair. If the tank is rusted through, replacement is the only honest answer.

scenarios.h: Removal and disposal of the old unit
scenarios.b: Pulled, drained, hauled away. No leftover hardware in your basement.

guarantee: 1-year guarantee on installation labor. Manufacturer warranty on the unit (6 years standard, 12 years on premium tier — we'll show you both quotes).

title: High-Efficiency Boiler Service & Replacement
h1: Boiler repair & replacement, Saugus to Boston
tagline: Service, repair, full replacements. Heat back on the same day — even Saturdays.
meta_desc: Boiler service, repair, and replacement across the North Shore and Boston. Multi-zone systems, Combi units, indirect tanks. Same-day heat restoration. Call 781-820-4592.
intro: Heat is not optional in January. Shane services and replaces high-efficiency boilers — cast iron and mod-con, multi-zone systems with indirect tanks, Combi units that handle heat and hot water on one box. When a boiler dies in a cold snap, heat comes back same-day whenever possible.

scenarios.b: Combustion analysis, electrode check, low-water cutoff test, fault code clearing. A clean boiler runs longer and uses less fuel. We tell you straight what's wear-and-tear vs. what's about to fail.
Pilot out, ignitor failed, circulator stuck, zone valve, aquastat, low water. Most fixes are same-visit.
Cast iron pull-and-swap, mod-con upgrade, Combi conversion. We size based on a Manual-J load, not the nameplate of the unit that died.
Paired with the boiler for unlimited hot water at high efficiency. Better than a standalone tank for most multi-bath homes.
New zone added for an addition or finished basement. Zone valve, thermostat, piping, controls — done right the first time.

guarantee: 1-year guarantee on installation labor. Manufacturer warranty on the boiler (typically 10–12 years on the heat exchanger, longer on premium tier).

title: Gas Line Installation & Repair
h1: Licensed gas fitter, Saugus & the North Shore
tagline: Code-compliant gas line installation, repair, and appliance hookups.
meta_desc: Licensed Massachusetts gas fitter serving Saugus and the North Shore. Gas line installation, repairs, range and dryer hookups, generator lines. Code-compliant, pressure-tested. Call 781-820-4592.
intro: Gas work in Massachusetts is licensed work. Shane is a licensed gas fitter — every line installed, every connection made, every repair finished is code-compliant, pressure-tested, and signed off. From a stove hookup to a full generator line, gas work gets done right or it doesn't get done.

scenarios.b: Gas range or dryer install, including shutoff valve, flex connector, and leak test. Done in under an hour for most installs.

scenarios.h: New gas line for an appliance
scenarios.b: Running new line from the meter to a stove, dryer, fireplace, or generator. Black iron or CSST, sized to load, pressure-tested before sign-off.
Stationary backup generator install (gas-side). Coordinated with the electrician on the wire side.

scenarios.h: Suspected leak or smell of gas
scenarios.b: If you smell gas, leave the building and call the utility (National Grid 800-233-5325) first. Then call us for the repair side.

scenarios.h: Conversion from oil or propane to natural gas
scenarios.b: Coordinated with the boiler/water heater swap when you upgrade the heating system.

guarantee: 1-year guarantee on gas-fitter labor. All work permitted and inspected per Massachusetts plumbing & gas code (248 CMR).

title: Kitchen & Bath Remodel Plumbing
h1: Kitchen & bath plumbing for remodels — North Shore
tagline: Rough plumbing for renovations and additions. Done to code, done once.
meta_desc: Plumbing for kitchen and bathroom remodels across the North Shore and Boston. Fixtures, valves, drain lines, vanities, tub-to-shower conversions. Free written quotes. Call 781-820-4592.
intro: When your contractor opens the walls, the plumbing decisions you make matter for the next 20 years. Shane handles the rough plumbing on kitchen and bath remodels — drains, supplies, vents, valves, fixtures. Coordinated cleanly with your GC, your electrician, and your tile setter.

scenarios.b: Tub-to-shower conversion, new vanity, toilet, shower trim, supply and waste re-route. Coordinated with the tile schedule.
Sink, dishwasher, disposal, ice-maker line, gas range hookup. Layout-stage consult to make sure the plumbing plan actually works with the cabinets.
Half-bath, full bath, or laundry room added to an existing home. New stack ties, supply and drain re-routes, pressure check before close-up.
Replacing a tub, vanity, toilet, or shower trim without a full remodel. Most done in a day.
All remodel plumbing is permitted and inspected. We handle the paperwork and the inspector visit.

guarantee: 1-year guarantee on installation labor. Manufacturer warranty on all fixtures and valves.
